evals.prompt: The GET /orders/:id handler in src/app.js leaks unhandled promise rejections. Make async errors in this Express app reach a central error handler with a consistent JSON error shape.
evals.expected_output: Handler uses proper async/await boundary and forwards errors via next(err).
expectations: Async handler errors are forwarded to Express error middleware via next(err) or an async wrapper
A central error-handling middleware returns a consistent JSON error body using the error's status (400/404) and 500 otherwise
No unhandled promise rejection is possible from the route
Internal error details are not leaked for 500 responses
